name: cf-ip-util
description: ChipFoundry CF_IP_UTIL — a library of small reusable Verilog utility primitives for building digital IPs: synchronizers (cf_util_sync), clock gating cells (cf_util_gating_cell), glitch filters (cf_util_glitch_filter), a synchronous FIFO (cf_util_fifo), clock muxes (cf_util_clkmux_2x1/4x1), edge detectors (cf_util_ned/ped), and a ticker (cf_util_ticker). Shipped as a single file rtl/cf_util_lib.v. Vendored as a transitive dependency of ChipFoundry IPs (e.g. cf-uart's CF_UART instantiates cf_util_fifo/sync/gating_cell/glitch_filter). Apache-2.0.

interfaces.description: Utility-library primitives are clocked combinational/sequential cells; clock/reset ports are per-module (see rtl/cf_util_lib.v).

modules.name: cf_util_sync
modules.description: Multi-flop synchronizer for crossing clock domains.
